title: MoarIceMod
description: This mod adds more frozen content to the game (like ice stairs).
body: Hello all and welcome to the Moar Ice Project! In this project, I am adding all sorts of ice related content for you (the viewer) to use. So far, I've added stairs, slabs, walls, and buttons for a few frozen blocks. There are also icicles avalible in creative mode and in the future, they will be implemented in world gen. If you like this project and would like more in it, please let me know!
